stories.title: Who's on the CFP bubble after the committee's third ranking?
stories.summary: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

stories.title: Wake Forest surges into CFP top 12; Bama stands pat as top 4 unchanged
stories.summary: Alabama stayed at No. 3 despite some struggles while two-loss Texas jumped one-loss Notre Dame for No. 5 in the CFP's latest rankings.

stories.title: Poch signs off with 'dream' USMNT finish, predicts 'big things in the future'
stories.summary: After coaching his last game as United States coach, Mauricio Pochettino said he thinks the team will "achieve big things" in the wake of his departure to Manchester United.

stories.title: Illinois' Stojakovic erupts for 46 in 'all-time' game at Duke; Scheyer calls Blue Devils 'soft'
stories.summary: Andrej Stojakovic scored 46 points, the most ever by an opponent at Duke, to highlight a dominating performance from No. 10 Illinois in a 99-78 victory Tuesday that ended the fifth-ranked Blue Devils' 35-game home winning streak.

stories.title: Sources: Steelers G McCormick avoided ankle fracture, could return for playoffs
stories.summary: Steelers guard Mason McCormick does not need surgery after he was carted off the field with an ankle injury, sources told NFL Network.
